postgres.comment: Read/write access to the Supabase Postgres prod DB. The connection string lives in apps/api/.env as DATABASE_URL. Only loads when DATABASE_URL is exported in the shell that started Claude. For triage of live data without writing throwaway scripts.

sentry.comment: Read prod errors from Sentry. Needs SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN (User Auth Token from Sentry → Settings → Account → API → Auth Tokens, scope project:read), SENTRY_ORG (your org slug), SENTRY_PROJECT (project slug).

firecrawl.comment: Web scraping for competitor research / SEO content gaps. Free tier 500 pages/mo at firecrawl.dev. Set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in your shell env before starting Claude.
